verdict.rationale: Probes confirm a live llms.txt at clerk.com/llms.txt and a markdown docs endpoint at clerk.com/docs.md. The docs also say any /docs, /changelog or /blog URL can be fetched as markdown by appending .md. Further agent-oriented surfaces include llms-full.txt, a per-section docs/llms.txt, changelog and dashboard llms.txt files, and an /agents page describing agents reading the docs. missing for 10: independent or community hands-on corroboration of agents successfully consuming these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: Append `.md` to any `/docs`, `/articles`, `/blog`, `/changelog`, or `/glossary` URL to get the page as markdown.
Claude Code reads the Clerk docs and wires auth straight into your app.
